entries.name: KATANA_API_KEY
entries.description: A Katana API key for the account's manufacturing orders and stock. Katana can't limit a key to reading, so it could also create and delete records; the connector only ever sends GET requests to the manufacturing orders and inventory lists. It goes only to Katana.
howToGet: In Katana, open Settings > API and choose Add new API key, named KaratOS.
Copy the key straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
